resources.string: Paste your own OAuth access token with the drive.readonly scope. Enable the Drive API in your own Google Cloud project. Tokens expire; replace the token here when authorization fails. Tokens are encrypted on this device.
Paste your own Microsoft Graph OAuth access token with the Files.Read delegated scope. Tokens expire; replace the token here when authorization fails. Tokens are encrypted on this device.
Online identification is not configured in this build. Build with your own TMDB credential; see README.
